name: git-visualizer
description: Git 仓库可视化管理工具

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: cd server && npx tsc && cd ../client && npx webpack --mode production
scripts.client: cd client && npx webpack serve --mode development
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.lint: cd server && npm run lint && cd ../client && npm run lint
